RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate a number from these facts

An all-male panel is worth asking about as a process concern, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your PhD and eight years of section leadership are substantial qualifications; the successful candidate’s relevant experience and the advertised selection criteria also matter.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the assessment criteria, how your qualifications were evaluated, and the policy on panel composition. Frame this as a request for transparency, not an accusation.

Stronger warning signs would include sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or departures from recruitment policy. Keep records and check local complaint deadlines promptly; awaiting an explanation may not pause them.
